mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS id,proj_nm AS name,ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",proj_stat_cd AS status, ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate",ctrt_amt AS "contractAmount" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}
SELECT dev_id AS id,mng_no AS "managementNo",dev_nm AS name,use_yn AS "useYn" FROM tb_hr_dev ORDER BY dev_id

SELECT dstrb_step_cd AS step,row_sn AS "rowSn",dstrb_ym AS month,row_type_cd AS "rowType",dev_id AS "developerId", item_nm AS "itemName",dstrb_amt AS amount FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb WHERE proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY dstrb_step_cd,row_sn,dstrb_ym

SELECT a.dev_id AS "developerId",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS name,m.input_ym AS month,sum(m.mon_mm) AS mm FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_pj_asgn_mon m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.proj_id=a.proj_id AND m.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' GROUP BY a.dev_id,d.mng_no,d.dev_nm,m.input_ym ORDER BY a.dev_id,m.input_ym

SELECT close_ym FROM tb_cl_close WHERE close_stat_cd='CLOSE' UNION SELECT input_ym FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND fix_yn='Y' UNION SELECT cost_ym FROM tb_co_mon_cost WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND fix_yn='Y'
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
mapper.select: SELECT rslt_sn AS sequence,rslt_type_cd AS severity,row_no AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS reason FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn

SELECT upld_id AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS filename,file_size AS size, reg_user_id AS actor,upld_stat_cd AS status,tot_row_cnt AS "totalRows",succ_cnt AS "successRows",warn_cnt AS "warningRows",err_cnt AS "errorRows", trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS step,aply_dttm AS "appliedAt" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT aft_val FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_SY_UPLD' AND trgt_key=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) AND chg_type_cd='NEW' AND chg_item_nm='검증 문맥' AND chg_rsn='B6' ORDER BY hist_id LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_pj_tk_dstrb WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND dstrb_step_cd=#{step}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
